claims.summary: Over any field, in a fixed degree-D PC pseudoideal, an acyclic product-only source with structural product weights s_a=h_a(delta_a+1)<=L, old coefficient maps of degree<=T>=1 and one fixed degree-b weight W has unique weighted product classes across successful prefix maps at b+2TL<=D. If any successful complete map exists, every successful prefix extends using its own coefficients followed by the complete map's coefficient polynomials with coherent rebuilding. Whole blocks from arbitrary successful complete maps with the same W,T can likewise be recombined. Block-local coefficient restrictions and supplied weighted coefficient-field memberships are retained; cross-block constraints, separate weights and individual-row mixing are not covered. Booleanity and weight survival are unnecessary for comparison. The proof uses actual-degree PC reuse, not uniform smaller NS certificates.
